messages:
ina: quick design question  proposing a toggle on first-run: 'Compact starter' (minimal cues + CTA) vs 'Guided walkthrough' (step-by-step drawer). want quick UX + a11y + telemetry thoughts.

finn: nice. compact starter reduces cognitive load. guided walkthrough helps conversion. maybe default to compact for new users and surface guided as an opt-in.

oliver: accessibility: toggle needs role="tablist"/role="tab" semantics or an aria-pressed segmented control. whichever, ensure keyboard arrow nav and distinct focus states. when walkthrough opens, move focus into the drawer and trap it.

marta: telemetry: new keys onboarding.toggle.view, onboarding.toggle.select, onboarding.walkthrough.open, onboarding.starter.cta. track user preference so we can respect it on return visits.

sam: microcopy: compact CTA "Try a quick start" vs "Explore samples"? prefer "Try a quick start" — more explicit. inside walkthrough CTA: "Mark step complete" -> shorter "Mark done".

ina: tiny clarification: if user picks compact and clicks CTA, do we show a tiny confirmation toast or open the sample drawer? UX OPS?

finn: open sample drawer anchored to the page so they can immediately run through. keep the interaction consistent whether they picked compact or guided.

oliver: focus behavior: if drawer opens, focus should land on the primary action. Esc closes and returns focus to the toggle. also ensure contrast of toggle labels hits 4.5:1. current token --muted-400 fails at 12px. bump weight or token.

marta: experiment draft: control = no toggle (current banner), variant A = toggle default compact, variant B = toggle default guided. primary metric = onboarding completion rate day 7; secondary = toggle adoption and preference retention.

sam: implementation note for eng: keep both UI panels in DOM and swap aria-hidden to avoid remounting; cheaper for state. tariq (cc) can you confirm for react hydration?

deploy-bot: reminder: onboarding surfaces design freeze Fri 5pm PT. link final comps to the release ticket.

ina: action items: sam - update copy in figma; oliver - confirm focus-ring spec + contrast tokens; marta - add telemetry keys and experiment config; finn - prototype toggle micro-interactions. syncing Thu 11am.

sam: will upload frames by Wed EOD and tag oliver. :thumbsup:

oliver: will check tokens and post accessible color alternatives. leaving thread open for any last nits.
